description: Localization and language settings for Greek ('el') for a calendar library, including month names, weekday names, date formats, and calendar labels.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Determines the correct month name form (nominative or genitive) based on context.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the meridiem indicator ('πμ' or 'μμ') based on the hour.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Checks if the given time is in the afternoon/evening (PM).

methods.name: calendar
methods.description: Generates calendar labels with correct prepositions based on the hour.
